evidenceKind: design-draft-correction; no production or device change
cause: Real App revisit and production facade show includeTimeline=false on newest-first summary pages. The draft copied the full sample timeline into Flash activity and fabricated generic legacy plan/log/binding metadata in History and the global inspector.
changes: Activity shows summary facts; Journal summary belongs to exact History detail.
Flash detail uses only explicit operation, certainty, target/binding and Artifact fields. Missing metadata is unreported.
Canonical sample lists actual published descriptor names, roles and privacy as design data; no actual byteCount or hash is invented.
Artifact cards fit the narrow History inspector; exact per-file previews distinguish sensitive and standard exports. Unpublished or absent artifacts cannot open an export preview.
Global inspector preserves supplied unknown/timeline facts and no longer invents flash.log for canonical or retained Flash records.

checks: Latest success / retained unknown / unresolved priority and exact History routing.
Journal summary in History only; Artifact cards do not clip the Export action.
Sensitive HiLog and standard report preview preserve exact filename and privacy.
Unknown detail has no fabricated Artifact inventory or export button.
browserChecks.boundary: Browser demo only; no Runtime connection, new Job or actual export.

coverage.inventoryCheck: Existing tests compare navigation, all App View declarations, preview files, report IDs and design inputs against current code. Passed within the 48 tests.

limitations: No production source, Runtime, Catalog, provider, admission or operation was changed.
This draft correction does not implement future capabilities explicitly marked unimplemented in the audit.
